classes.purpose: Static game-data record describing a single pet skill definition (id, level, name, category/pet-type, weight, tier, linked buffs and effect animation). All records live in a CInfoManager<CPetSkillInfo> singleton indexed by skill id; this bundle contains the runtime query/apply/selection helpers that operate over that record set and over the player's equipped-skill lists (TlvSkillSlotData / TlvSkillGroupData) and the buff system.
classes.notes: Every method in the bundle was auto-labeled 'CPetSkillInfo::GetManagers' by Ghidra; this is wrong. The real shared idiom is CInfoManager lookup: FUN_1051c550(0,"CPetSkillInfo",0) / FUN_11679e10 return the manager, and records are fetched by the sparse-id formula (see formulas). NO XML/TLV reader (Read_0x99) is present in this bundle, so the CPetSkillInfo struct is loaded elsewhere; field offsets below are INFERRED from the serializer/printer builders (112f6b70, 112f73a0, 112f6dd0) and the debug-log selector (1158b730). Cross-ref: the short* list processed by 11584a50/11588cc0 (count at [0], entries stride 6 shorts, sub-block at short offset 0x3d = byte 61) matches TlvSkillSlotData (count int16 @0, slotCount sub-struct @offset 61) and TlvSkillGroupData (skillGroup/skillCnt/skillID[]). Treat the field table as medium-confidence.
formulas: CInfoManager sparse-id lookup (used everywhere): idx = id - base(mgr+0x30); valid if 0 <= idx < capacity(mgr+0x24); bucket = *(int*)(mgr+0x20 + (idx / bucketSize(mgr+0x28))*4); record = *(int*)(bucket + (idx % bucketSize)*4).
CInfoManager linear enumeration: count = (mgr+0x18 - mgr+0x14)>>2; record[i] = *(int*)(*(mgr+0x14) + i*4).

Weighted random skill pick (1158b730): total = sum over list of record[+0x50]; rand = frand() * _DAT_11de98f0 * (total-1); iterate list subtracting record[+0x50] from rand, pick the record at which the running value first goes < 1; result id written to *param_3.
Skill effect rate (113f0ca0 / 113f0ff0): FUN_113e5380(animId, 0, (float)(record[+0xb0] / DAT_11de99b8)) — +0xb0 is an integer rate divided by a constant to a float.

Passive/aura match filter (11589800 / 115899c0 / 11589b80): apply if (record[+0x44]==0x12 || record[+0x44]==target[+0x70]) && tier rule on record[+0x70] vs target[+0x6c] (both <3, or 2<record<=target) && record[+0x48] <= target[+0x48] && record[+0x4c]!=0 && !FUN_1174ca30(record[+0x10]).
Next-level existence (112f4fe0 / 115889c0): true if some other record has other[+0x24]==rec[+0x24] && other[+0x14]==rec[+0x14]+1 (same skill group id, level+1).
Per-category cap on equipped list (11584a50): entries grouped by record[+0x58]; local_30[category] counter incremented, gated by FUN_1174bf40(category, currentCount); records with +0x58 < 6 rejected.

fields.name: displayId
fields.note: Buff/effect instance key; printed as first '%d' in debug log; passed to FUN_1174ca30/FUN_10461ba0 (is-active / activate).

fields.name: level
fields.note: Skill level; next-level checks use level+1.

fields.name: skillGroupId
fields.note: Primary lookup/group key; find-by-id compares +0x24; map/tree keyed on +0x24.

fields.name: classTag_0x44
fields.note: Type/class tag; 0x12 acts as wildcard matching target[+0x70].

fields.name: weight
fields.note: Probability weight for weighted-random pick; summed as 'total count'.

fields.name: category
fields.note: Skill category / pet skill slot type; observed values 4,6,7,8,9; used as grouping index and cap key.

fields.name: tier_0x70
fields.note: Tier/rank used in passive match against target[+0x6c].

fields.name: linkedSkillIds
fields.note: Array of 5 related/prerequisite skill ids iterated in HasLinkedSkillActive (11588460).

fields.name: actionName
fields.note: Action/animation name resolved via FUN_113ad880 to an anim id.

fields.name: rate_0xb0
fields.note: Integer rate; divided by DAT_11de99b8 to a float passed to FUN_113e5380.

fields.name: buffRef_0xb4
fields.note: Effect/buff object applied via vtable(+0x44); released in ReleaseBuffRefs.

fields.name: buffRef_0xb8
fields.note: Second effect/buff object; conditionally applied to target; released in ReleaseBuffRefs.

methods.purpose: One-time registration/init of the CInfoManager<CPetSkillInfo> singleton name; returns the cached manager pointer holder (DAT_123be4d8).
Given a skill id, looks up its record and scans a vector for an entry with same skillGroupId(+0x24) and level(+0x14)+1; returns bool (upgrade exists in list).
Iterates an {id,extra} pair container, resolves each record and appends 60-byte detail entries (name, desc, level, id, category, params 0x64/0x68/0x6c/0x70/0x94) to an output vector.
When manager sub-flag==1, enumerates all records and emits 20-byte summary entries {level, displayId, category, val_0x60} into an output vector.
Builds a grouped/nested list of skills filtered by category(+0x58)==param, emitting 44-byte inner records (strings, level, id, tier params) grouped into 20-byte outer buckets.
Gets up to 10 candidate ids (FUN_100ec450 over world+0xc4), keeps records with category(+0x58)==6, appends their ids to an output vector.

For an entity's skill manager (+0x1ed4, gated by flag +0x1f14), iterates records and plays each skill's action animation (FUN_113ad880 name -> FUN_113e5380 with rate +0xb0). Tail-calls PlaySkillEffectsFromList (113f0ff0).
Gets up to 10 skill ids and for each record plays the action animation, spawns buffRef_0xb4 via vtable, and conditionally applies buffRef_0xb8 to a queried target object.
Teardown pass: enumerates sub-managers, and for each active skill record with category(+0x58)!=4 removes its buff via target vtable(+0x4c)(record[+0xb8],1); clears a busy flag.

Validates an equipped-skill short-list (count@[0], stride-6 entries): drops entries with invalid/low-category records or duplicates, groups by category with per-category caps (FUN_1174bf40), compacts the list in place.
Iterates a skill container and calls FUN_11589550 on each resolved record (per-skill activate/register action).
Iterates a skill container and calls FUN_11589640 on each resolved record (mirror of 11586f40, likely deactivate/unregister).
Iterates skill container; for records passing availability checks (FUN_1158acd0 on id/val_0x94, FUN_1158add0), runs FUN_11589640 then queues a buff/effect via owner vtable(+0x54)/(+0x64).
For skill id param_2, iterates its 5 linkedSkillIds(+0x80) and checks (FUN_117575f0) whether any linked skill is present/active in the given list; returns bool.
Partial/thunk fragment (uses in_EAX/unaff_EBP): scans a list for a record whose skillGroupId(+0x24) equals a target id; returns match bool.
Looks up a record by id, then scans a list for an entry with same skillGroupId(+0x24) and level(+0x14) >= record level; returns bool.
Looks up a record by id, then scans a list for an entry with same group and level == record level+1; returns bool (variant of 112f4fe0).

Deserializes an equipped-skill short-buffer (TlvSkillSlotData-like): builds a 12-byte {id,extra,category} vector, then loads the slot sub-block (short offset 0x3d = byte 61) into a red-black tree keyed by id.
Enumerates all records and applies each passive skill matching the target's class/tier/level filter (see formula); activate path uses FUN_11589340.
Same passive-apply logic as 11589800 but activation uses FUN_115892e0 (variant B).
Passive-apply variant requiring extra flag +0x4d and using FUN_11589390 (variant C).
Collects skills of categories 6,7,8,9 (FUN_11587830) and inserts each into a map keyed by skillGroupId(+0x24) storing level(+0x14) — best-level-per-group across those categories.
Single-category version of 11589d20: fetches skills of one category and inserts group->level pairs into a map.
Counts records in a list whose activeFlag(+0x54)==1 and whose id differs from owner[+0x58]; returns count.
Counts records in a list whose category(+0x58) equals param_2; returns count.
Iterates an 8-byte-stride pair vector; for each resolved record inserts skillGroupId(+0x24)->level(+0x14) into an output map.

Weighted-random skill selection from an id list using record weight(+0x50); writes chosen id to *param_3. Optionally dumps a PetSkill_HH-MM-SS-n.log with per-entry '%d[%d]' (displayId/weight), total count, rand, and result (gated by owner flag +0x8c).
Uses a secondary registry (FUN_11679c30, vector at +0x3b754/+0x3b758) to test whether any record has skillGroupId(+0x24)==param_1; returns bool.
Linear scan of all records; returns the first record pointer whose skillGroupId(+0x24)==param_1 (core GetInfoById).
Linear scan; returns the record whose skillGroupId(+0x24)==param_1 and level(+0x14)==param_2.
Releases the object's CBuffInfo handles (word slots 0x2d..0x30 => buffRef fields), then calls ReleaseBuffRefHelper (11759b90) for the two skill-buff slots [0x2f]/[0x30].
Validates a CBuffInfo id (param_2) against its manager, then walks the CPetSkillInfo records to release/detach the buff reference (helper of 117599f0).
Iterates every valid CPetSkillInfo record and calls ReleaseBuffReferences (117599f0) on the given object.
Walks all CPetSkillInfo records (no side effect beyond the enumeration/validation loop); likely a preload/touch or count-all pass.

nameNext.why: The universal accessor FUN_1051c550(0,"CPetSkillInfo",0) returning the CInfoManager for a named info class; naming it clarifies every method here.
Second manager-resolution helper used in the cached-singleton idiom throughout the bundle.
Called with (animId, 0, rate) to drive a skill's action animation; core of the effect-apply methods.
Red-black-tree insert used by the BuildSkillLevelMap family keyed on skillGroupId.
Fills a vector of skill ids for a given category; the input to several map builders.
Predicate on record displayId(+0x10) gating passive-skill application.
